docs.description: Large selectable card that behaves as a rich radio or checkbox — icon, title and description the user picks from a small set. 3 variants: state (default, hover, selected). selected uses border + surface tint, never colour alone; focus and disabled come from the nested control. The whole card is the label and the hit target; group with role=radiogroup and a legend. For dense or long lists use Radio, Checkbox or Option Row.
